info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers Domain APIs API
Check whether a domain is available for registration or not.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name whose availability is to be checked.

params.name: source
params.description: Specify the data source for domain availability checks. Use "dns" for DNS-based lookups or "whois" for WHOIS-based lookups. By default, "dns" is used.

items.docs: The Domain Search API is designed to simplify the process of finding available domain names across all top-level domains (TLDs) and second-level domains (SLDs).

info.name: Check the availability of multiple domains in a single request.

params.name: source
params.description: Specify the data source for domain availability checks. Use "dns" for DNS-based lookups or "whois" for WHOIS-based lookups. By default, "dns" is used.

items.docs: Perform Bulk Domain Availability checks using a list of domains. Supports upto `100 Domains Per Request`.

info.name: Check domain availability and receive suggestions for related domains.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name for availability and suggestions.

params.name: source
params.description: Specify the data source for domain availability checks. Use "dns" for DNS-based lookups or "whois" for WHOIS-based lookups. By default, "dns" is used.

params.name: sug
params.description: Set to false to get a single availability result for exactly the given domain (same shape as the Domain Availability API), with no suggestions. Omitting this parameter, or setting it to true, returns an array of suggested alternate-TLD domains instead — despite the parameter's name, omitting it does not behave like false.

params.name: count
params.description: Requested number of suggestions. Observed behavior: the API returns at least 5 alternate-TLD suggestions regardless of a lower count value; recognizable/brandable domains can return more than requested, drawn from a larger suggestion pool.

items.docs: The Domain Search API is designed to simplify the process of finding available domain names across all top-level domains (TLDs) and second-level domains (SLDs).

info.name: Get subdomains related to the given domain name.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name for availability and suggestions.

params.name: after
params.description: Filter subdomains seen after this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: before
params.description: Filter subdomains seen before this date( format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter subdomains by status (active or inactive).

items.docs: The Subdomain Lookup API is designed to retrieve subdomains related to the given domain name. It helps you explore subdomains that are available for registration or usage.
